experiments.name: uf_shared_source
experiments.rationale: Single-source preference dataset with rich prompt/chosen/rejected structure; supports fair conversion into SFT/DPO/RLHF/self-distill views.

views.rlhf: use prompt + chosen/rejected to train reward model and PPO policy
views.self_distill: use prompt only; on-policy outputs generated by current model

experiments.name: hh_shared_source
experiments.rationale: Helpful-Harmless preference pairs from one source; enables apples-to-apples comparison across training paradigms with consistent data provenance.

views.rlhf: use prompt + chosen/rejected to train reward model and PPO policy
views.self_distill: use prompt only; on-policy outputs generated by current model

experiments.name: stereoset_shared_source
experiments.rationale: Explicit stereotype/anti-stereotype examples across gender/race/religion/profession; useful for bias-sensitive training and amplification analysis.

views.rlhf: reward anti-stereotype over stereotype from same prompt
views.self_distill: use the same stereotype-sensitive prompts for on-policy generation
